effects.name: Impact frames
effects.hint: How you see frames on decisive hits. Only for you.

slow.name: Slow motion
slow.hint: Show frames this many times slower, to study them. 1 is normal speed. Only for you.

onKill.name: Decisive: target drops
onKill.hint: A frame when a hit brings the target to 0 HP.

onCrit.name: Decisive: critical hit
onCrit.hint: A frame when the damage comes from a critical hit.

onHeavy.name: Decisive: heavy hit
onHeavy.hint: A frame when one hit takes a large share of the target's maximum HP.

heavyShare.name: Heavy hit, % of maximum HP
heavyShare.hint: How much of the target's maximum HP one hit must take to count as heavy.

onLastEnemy.name: Decisive: last enemy
onLastEnemy.hint: A frame when the last creature of its side falls in combat.

who.name: Whose hits
who.hint: Only player characters, or every creature including monsters.

oncePerTurn.name: At most one frame per turn
oncePerTurn.hint: In combat, show no more than one frame per turn — the moment stays special.

sound.name: Frame sound
sound.hint: A sound file for the frame. Empty — the impact is synthesized in the browser.

Warn.target: Select the attacker's token and target the victim (T).
